notes.title: Patch Notes - September 26, 2025
notes.content:
[b]Enhanced Ball Physics[/b]
The ball physics system has been refined and now runs fully on its own dedicated CPU thread, delivering a more consistent and responsive pinball experience, unaffected by frame rate (FPS).

[b]CPU Performance Optimizations[/b]
New optimizations reduce CPU load, ensuring smoother performance across a wide range of devices.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Several bugs reported by the community have been fixed, including issues with upscaler modes and other minor glitches. Thank you for your valuable feedback and continued support!

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.1
notes.content:
This update brings major performance improvements. You can expect 20-30% fps boost, depending on your hardware.

In particular, VR performance and quality has been significantly enhanced, and you can now adjust VR settings directly from the main menu.

Additionally, this patch introduces support for AMD FSR3 and a diverter mechanic has been added to the top of the playfield.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 13/08/2025
notes.content:
- [b]DMD[/b] now tracks persistent mode progress all the time

- [b]Special Modes[/b] now correctly receive keyboard input

- [b]Ball bounce[/b] from power target fixed. Ball speed also reduced when coming out of the loop.

- [b]Multiball lock[/b] should not drop balls to play accidentally anymore.

- [b]Fly activation[/b] transition bug fixed.

- [b]Audio Master Volume:[/b] Setting music or master volume to zero does not prevent game mode activation anymore.

- [b]Texture Quality[/b] settings now load correctly when starting map
 
- [b]VPIN Anaglyph 3D:[/b] Added more options to Anaglyph 3D

- [b]VPIN Quick Start[/b] is now fixed. Press left or right flipper, or start button right after start loading screen ends to quick start VPIN mode.

- [b]VPIN SSF settings[/b] now save and load all channels correctly. Output channel names may still differ from your cabinet’s configuration.

- [b]VPIN Input[/b] bug where flipper input keybinds stopped working after the first played game has been fixed.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 04/08/2025
notes.content:
[b]Display Settings [/b]
You can now adjust Exposure from Graphics Settings 
HDRI Profiles + Display Gamma added to VPIN display settings
Anaglyph 3D feature added to VPIN Cabinet Display Setup

[b]Full Xbox Controller Support  [/b]

[b]Keybinds [/b]
You can now set also keyboard and mouse keys to VPIN keybinds.  
Possibility to reset keybinds to default added. 

[b]Window focus fixed when starting VPIN Mode [/b]
The game window now receives focus correctly after a VPIN quick launch, and you no longer need to click the mouse to start the game.

[b]SSF Configuration [/b]
Now correctly saves and loads Side Surround and Rear Exciter Channel settings
 
[b]Cabinet reset fixed [/b]

+ other reported bugs fixed

notes.title: Hotfix 02/08/2025
notes.content:
[b]Possibility to restart Pinball cabinet during the game[/b]
In desktop mode restart can be found from menu. In VPIN you can do this currently only with mouse from menu, but I will add possibility to bind cabinet button to next patch. VR restart button will be also added on next update. Currently you can't restart machine in VR.  

[b]Menus can be now navigated also with gamepad[/b]
Use left thumbstick to move the cursor. A/X button to select depending the gamepad you use. (Currently disabled from VPIN Configuration Menu). More improvements to menu navigation coming later.

[b]Desktop Front Panel mouse cursor bug [/b]
When playing with gamepad, front panel now shows cursor correctly and you don't need to move mouse anymore to see the cursor.

[b]Mouse left-click keybind bug fixed[/b]
Fixed bug where binding A on Xbox-style controllers conflicted with the left mouse button. 

[b]SSF Channels are now correctly routed and named[/b]
Corrected routing for Side Surround and Rear Exciter audio output channels.

[b]VPIN Configuration menu default rotation is now saved [/b]
The system now retains the last orientation set for the VPIN menu. 

[b]First Launch crash [/b]
Many people have experienced first launch crash. Only happens first time you start the game in desktop or VR mode. I think it's now fixed but I'm not 100% sure 🙂

+ other reported small bugs fixed.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix 30/07/25
notes.content:
[b]Performance Improvements on level loading[/b]
Loading Desktop or VR level has been causing crashes on 16GB RAM machines.
Set Texture Quality from Main Menu to Low if you are still experiencing crashes on the level load. Setting Texture Quality to Low, now also turns animated materials to static to save memory.

[b]Ball stuck at the end of left ramp[/b]
Bug that caused ball to be stuck at the end of the left rail while building multiball should be now fixed

[b]Plunger bug[/b]
Bug that caused ball to roll over the plunger should be now fixed.

[b]VR start button[/b]
Button reset bug fixed

[b]VPIN Quick Start[/b]
Works now also without account log in.

[b]VPIN Flipper SSF[/b]
Flipper SSF configuration not reseting anymore after played game.

[b]VPIN VR Controllers [/b]
You can now use cabinet / controller start button to start machine in VR mode.

[b]Right Mushroom Multiball Bug[/b]
During multiball, shooting two balls at the same time to the mouth of the right mushroom caused bug. This is fixed now.

[b]Breathe Underwater Achievement[/b]
Achievement Progress is now tracked correctly

[b]Tilting the machine[/b]
When you tilt the machine, all balls at the end of the left rail are released.

[b]Fly mode[/b]
Fly mode can be now activated only once in a game.

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]You can now play without creating an account[/b]
[url=https://infectedpinball.com/justplay.jpg]Just Play[/url]

[b]Reduced RAM Usage[/b]
Memory usage has been optimized to lower overall RAM consumption, improving stability on 16 GB systems.

[b]Updated PSO Cache[/b]
Precompiled shader data (PSO cache) has been updated.
